metadata.title: SOCRadar Alarms for Microsoft Sentinel
metadata.description: Bidirectional integration: Import SOCRadar alarms to Sentinel, sync closed incidents back to SOCRadar. Includes optional audit logging, custom alarms table for analytics, and Workbook dashboard.
metadata.author: SOCRadar

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics Workspace Name
Location/region of the Log Analytics workspace (e.g., centralus, northeurope). Must match your existing workspace region.
How often to check for new alarms (1-60 minutes)
How far back to look on first run (default: 600 = 10 hours)
Import all alarm statuses (OPEN, RESOLVED, MITIGATED, FALSE_POSITIVE). Default: only OPEN
Log all operations to Log Analytics for auditing
Store alarms in custom Log Analytics table (SOCRadar_Alarms_CL) for analytics and KQL queries
Data retention in days for custom tables (30-730, default: 1 year)
Internal: Logic Apps start 3 min after deploy for role propagation
Resource group of existing Sentinel workspace. Leave default if workspace is in same RG.
Sentinel role for Logic Apps. Responder sufficient for incident ops (least-privilege).

Extract IP, domain and URL indicators from alarm details and attach them to the incident as entities. Requires Microsoft Sentinel Contributor for the import playbook because bookmark write is not included in Responder. When false, the import identity keeps the SentinelRoleLevel role.

body.query: print raw = base64_decode_tostring('@{base64(outputs('Compose_IoC_Source'))}') | extend Urls0 = extract_all(@'(https?://[^\s"<>\]\)},;\\]+)', raw) | extend nourl = replace_regex(raw, @'https?://[^\s"<>\]\)},;]+', ' ') | extend Ips0 = extract_all(@'\b((?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9])(?:\.(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9])){3})\b', nourl) | extend Doms0 = extract_all(@'\b((?:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}\.)+[a-z]{2,24})\b', tolower(nourl)) | mv-expand D = iff(array_length(Doms0) == 0, dynamic(['']), Doms0) to typeof(string) | where isempty(D) or (D != 'socradar.com' and D !endswith '.socradar.com' and not(D matches regex @'\.(png|jpe?g|gif|svg|ico|css|js|txt|json|xml|csv|pdf|docx?|xlsx?|pptx?|exe|dll)$')) | summarize Ips0 = take_any(Ips0), Urls0 = take_any(Urls0), Doms = make_set_if(D, isnotempty(D)) | mv-expand U = iff(array_length(Urls0) == 0, dynamic(['']), Urls0) to typeof(string) | extend U = trim_end(@'[.,;:!?\\]+', U) | summarize Ips0 = take_any(Ips0), Doms = take_any(Doms), Urls = make_set_if(U, isnotempty(U)) | project Ips = array_sort_asc(set_union(Ips0, dynamic([]))), Domains = array_sort_asc(set_union(Doms, dynamic([]))), Urls = array_sort_asc(set_union(Urls, dynamic([])))

properties.notes: IP / Domain / URL indicators automatically extracted (regex) from SOCRadar alarm Details and Content fields. Hashes intentionally excluded.

IoC_Enrichment_Status.inputs: IoC entity enrichment step finished (see Enrich_Incident_Entities scope for details). Incident creation is never blocked by enrichment errors.
